              Keyboard shortcuts

              Letter and symbol keys act only while focus is outside a text field. Turn them off if they get in the way; Escape, Home, and End keep working.

              ] and [Next and previous tool call

              /Filter sessions, tool calls, or context

              EndJump to the newest entry and follow
